cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For my restaurant, your flying chair must come with a flying table. Dinner travels with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the table circle the room. Would that suit you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only with a hovering waiter. I won't have my customers calling down for soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve upside down. Shall I put that in the quote?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Include gravity-proof soup before you send it. I decide the menu, and turning customers over between courses is not on it.
